basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign the operating model of its five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance) and plan the transition?

sub_questions.question: How do the five units operate today in structure, processes and performance?
Which pain points and improvement areas must the new operating model address?
What target operating model (structure, roles, governance) can the executive committee approve?
How is the target model detailed for each unit with that unit's leaders?
What transition plan moves each unit from today's way of working to the target model?

drivers.evidence: all five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance)

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Five units diagnosed two at a time in three rounds; executive interviews run alongside. Above the typical 4-8 weeks: no unit is sampled.

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phase_work.why: Target model, then unit designs two at a time in three rounds, then the transition plan. Above typical 6-10 weeks: five units detailed.

sizing.levers: Diagnosing three units at once instead of two saves 2-3 weeks; drafting the transition plan alongside the last unit designs saves 1-2 more.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how the five business units work today and which pain points the new operating model must address.

gate.label: Priorities sign-off
gate.decision: Which improvement areas does Design take forward?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target operating model, detail each unit's design with its leaders and set the transition plan by unit.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the executive committee approve the target model and transition plan?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: the phases total 20-24 weeks, taken as the middle of wider estimates, so confirm it before quoting.
Design reaches its 15-week top if the target model takes six weeks, unit designs two weeks each and the transition plan two.
No Implementation phase: the type is assessment, so Design plans the transition; confirm the client does not expect execution support.
